notes: TCG overhaul: a cleaner table, full-art cards, and packs to open. Win matches to earn Obols, buy packs and collect cards, with rare alternate-art printings that show the hero's skins. Build your own 20-card deck (up to 2 copies of each card). 11 new spell cards. Hover over a card to see its stats. A proper Victory screen with your hero of the match, stats and rewards. If you win the coin flip, you choose whether to go first or second.
